A table-side pronunciation sheet, not lore. Say these out loud once before session one. Respellings, not IPA — stress in CAPITALS, syllables hyphenated.

  • ✓ verified — checked against a source.
  • • standard — ordinary English usage, not separately verified.
  • ⚠ your call — invented here or genuinely contested. There is no fact to get right; pick one and be consistent.

General rule for 1892 London: English place names are shorter than they look. When in doubt, swallow the middle.

• Marylebone — MARR-uh-luh-bun (⚠⚠ never "Mary-lee-bone"; in 1892 the L-less MARR-i-bun was standard — the Lodge's own address)
  • Clerkenwell — CLARK-en-wel
  • Southwark — SUTH-uk (silent w)
  • Greenwich — GREN-itch
  • Woolwich — WOOL-itch
  • Deptford — DET-f'd
  • Holborn — HOH-b'n (⚠ HOL-born now common)
  • Rotherhithe — ROTH-er-hyth
  • Wapping — WOP-ing
  • Spitalfields — SPIT-'l-feelds
  • Whitechapel — WYTE-chap-'l
  • Limehouse — LYME-house
  • Bloomsbury — BLOOMZ-bree
  • Hampstead — HAMP-stid
  • Tilbury — TIL-bree
  • Kensal Green — KEN-s'l
  • Brompton Oratory — BROMP-t'n ORR-uh-tree
  • Rosslyn — ROZ-lin
  • Pendle — PEN-d'l

• Esther Hesketh — ESS-ter HESS-kith (⚠ Esther is still a suggestion)
  • Giacomo Fugo — JAH-koh-moh FOO-goh (Gia- is jah, never gee-)
  • Josiah Vane — joh-ZY-uh VAYN
  • Cordelia Ashe — kor-DEE-lee-uh ASH
  • Harry Wray — RAY (⚠ GM-only character)
  • Sylvia Threlfall — SIL-vee-uh THREL-fawl
  • Serious Chapel — CHAP-'l (the given name is the joke; play it straight)
  • Mrs. Pargeter — PAR-jit-er (soft g)
  • Rosa Lee — ROH-zuh LEE
  • Danior Lee — DAN-ee-or (⚠ Romani given name; decide and hold it — he recurs all year)
  • Ellersley — EL-erz-lee

• Johann Van Helsing — YOH-hahn (⚠⚠ German J is Y; head of the order, said constantly)
  • Abraham Van Helsing — AY-bruh-ham
  • Jekyll — JEE-k'l (⚠ JEK-'l near-universal now; be consistent)
  • Moreau — mor-ROH (silent -eau)
  • Carmilla — kar-MIL-uh
  • Dracula — DRAK-yuh-luh
  • Frankenstein — FRANK-en-styne
  • Renfield — REN-feeld
  • Edward Kelley — KEL-ee (⚠ GM-only — never say in front of players)

⚠ Serviceable English renderings, not Arabic instruction. If a player speaks Arabic, defer to them and correct this.

  • Medjay — MED-jye
  • Mohammed al-Arabi — al-AH-rah-bee
  • Zeinab Hafiz — ZAY-nab HAH-fiz
  • Girgis Bishara — GEER-gis bi-SHAH-rah (Coptic; hard g)
  • Idris — ID-riss (⚠ ee-DREES closer to Arabic)
  • Yusuf al-Tahtawi — YOO-suf at-tah-TAH-wee (✓ note at-, not al- — sun-letter assimilation)
  • Sosra — SOS-ruh
  • Imhotep — im-HOH-tep (not an antagonist in this campaign)

• James Melmoth — MEL-moth (-moth as the insect)
  • "Angus McBane" — mak-BAYN (his Scottish alias)
  • Charles Maturin — MAT-yoo-rin (⚠ real author; usage varies)
  • Loughrea — lok-RAY (⚠ the -gh- is a hard k)
  • Cloonvara — kloon-VAR-uh (⚠ invented townland candidate)
  • Ardnabrone — ard-nuh-BROHN (⚠ invented; wants a gazetteer check)

• Ilie — ee-LEE-eh (✓ Romanian form of Elijah)
  • A. J. Raffles — RAF-'lz (⚠ no public reputation in 1892 — not a clue)
  • "Bunny" Manders — MAN-derz
  • Nadja — NAHD-yuh (j is y)
  • Elena — eh-LEH-nuh
  • Prince Dakkar — DAK-ar (Nemo)
  • Rev. Aitken — AY-kin (⚠ the t is silent)
  • Overseer Voss — VOSS
  • Lindenbocker — LIN-den-bok-er
  • Janik — YAH-nik
  • Petru — PET-roo

• Miasma — mee-AZ-muh
  • Aether — EE-ther
  • Enochian — ee-NOH-kee-an
  • Guise — GYZE (rhymes with eyes; ⚠ players will read it as "geez" once)
  • Zenit — ZEN-it (the Lodge's ledger currency)
  • Rippertech — RIP-er-tek
  • Keystone — KEE-stohn
